title: Every condition that holds back a SEND post, a receive post or a consumer's read, 2026-11-02
revision: mesh 212f8e8e (line numbers; the audited lines are unchanged from 62382113 and 81ad6576)
method: static reading only; no runs, probes or builds

classes.a: a true data edge (RAW: consumer after landing; forwarding SEND after its landing; SEND after its producer's stores; or a WAR inside one call's declared value versions)
classes.b: a named hardware limit with its number
classes.c: a re-implementation of what the provider already guarantees
classes.d: a guard against page reuse that page assignment should answer instead
classes.e: defensive or bound machinery on the hot path

violations.effector decides: a condition, choice, wait, bound, retry or check inside an effector
violations.effector computes a map: an effector derives at run time a unit-to-page or unit-to-descriptor map the chooser already decided
violations.chooser holds pointer: a pointer, byte offset, (buffer, offset) pair or region offset used to make a decision

rows.withholds: SEND post and receive post: every unit of a stream
rows.waits_on: the stream's owner word (holder's take, holder's give, MESH_STREAM_GIVEN for a holder gone) and the link's served lanes
rows.advanced_by: the holder process; the bridge's event loop for a holder gone; the port child's connect and loss
rows.cost: per pass per stream: one acquire load of owner, two compares; per pass per port: one acquire load of served. Nothing per unit.
rows.endorsed_form: Keep. It runs per pass, not per unit, and it is the holding's grace period (2548cbce; design/reclamation-2026-10-30.md). Without it a dead holder's units would be posted.
rows.handles: Post nothing of a holding whose holder gave it or died, and free the stream once nothing of it is outstanding.

where: rdma/nccl-mesh.c:4865-4885 (zinth), emitted first in the occurrence at 5794
rdma/nccl-mesh-metal.m:507 and 529 (administrative: no page relation, frame UINT32_MAX)
rdma/torch-mesh/torch_mesh/_stream.mm:1129 (an administrative command placed at the occurrence's base)
rows.withholds: every receive post of the occurrence on that stream, and of every later occurrence on it
rows.waits_on: the predecessor's next word (the stream's zwoggle for the first occurrence) holding this occurrence's table offset
rows.advanced_by: the GPU link dispatch (KIND_publish, one threadgroup) at the occurrence's own position in the function
rows.cost: One single-threadgroup dispatch per channel per occurrence; a dispatch boundary costs 1-2 us (design/hardware-and-discipline.md section 1). Each runs one threadgroup barrier, one system-scope seq_cst fence and one system atomic max (nccl-mesh-kernels.h:55-57, 129; mesh.metal:114-118). The wait: receives post only once the GPU reaches the occurrence; a peer's SEND that comes first waits in TN3205's credit. Measured: the five-rank LSTM's 77-101 ms ticks, against 0.28-0.31 ms waits in the fast run (metal-microbench docs/facts.md, 2026-11-02); d-r41's links each follow the readers of the reused h, and the next waits on their words are 85-92 ms (extras/wait_report.py, 534f5709).
rows.endorsed_form: Both halves: (1) distinct landing generations where landings are reused (the LSTM's h), as torch_mesh/chain.py operands does (two page generations; the recurrent gather one framed occurrence at the window's start); (2) each link recorded at the earliest order its landing pages allow: the function's start where no earlier command touches them.

repair_order.why: milliseconds a tick: the LSTM's 77-101 ms; one change removes both
waits across nodes when bound; one load a unit or a threadgroup otherwise; one change (distinct generations) removes all three
a whole-source copy ahead of the first SEND
a compare and an acquire load a unit on both walks
one pass's delay past 64 units; replace with the chained post, not by deletion
keep: per pass, failure-only, or off the hot path
